subject: Trump’s overseas data center tax 💸, Tesla rolls out FSD v15 🚗, Google's quantum processor ⚛️
notes: Headlines in the plain-text body are in capitals; quotes keep that casing. The SpaceX $43B item is a debt package, recorded as 'other', not a round.

stories.headline: Ant Group leads $100M pre-Series A in Simplexity Robotics at a $1.6B valuation
stories.quote: ANT GROUP LEADS A $100M PRE-SERIES A IN CHINESE HUMANOID STARTUP SIMPLEXITY ROBOTICS AT A $1.6B VALUATION

facts.text: Existing backers Alibaba and Tencent also took part.
facts.quote: The round also drew existing backers Alibaba and Tencent into the same cap table.

stories.headline: Trump says the US will tax American companies that build data centers abroad
stories.quote: At a White House press conference, Trump promised a "tremendous tax" on US firms building data centers overseas, specifically naming a proposed Google facility in Finland.

facts.text: Chinese firms rent restricted GPUs from data centers in countries that can import them; a new Commerce licensing rule targets this.
facts.quote: Chinese firms rent restricted GPUs from data centers in countries that can legally import them, which is the route Commerce's new licensing rule targets.

stories.headline: US intelligence reportedly tracked Megaspeed executive Alice Huang's contacts with China's spy agency for over a year
stories.quote: Megaspeed, the Singapore operator suspected of diverting restricted Nvidia chips, is now a focus of the investigations, which are continuing.

facts.text: Alice Huang was in touch with a Ministry of State Security officer from Spring 2025 until this fall.
facts.quote: Alice Huang, a Megaspeed executive, was in touch with a Ministry of State Security officer from Spring 2025 until this fall, overlapping with her relationship with Jensen Huang.

facts.text: Trump was briefed at least twice.
facts.quote: Trump was briefed at least twice.

stories.headline: Tesla rolls out FSD v15 with a vision encoder shared across FSD, Robotaxi and Optimus
stories.quote: TESLA ROLLS OUT FSD V15 WITH A VISION ENCODER SHARED ACROSS FSD, ROBOTAXI, AND OPTIMUS, CLAIMING 25X BETTER CRITICAL INTERVENTION RATE

facts.text: Tesla published only the 25x multiplier, not the underlying intervention rate.
facts.quote: Tesla published only the 25x multiplier, not the underlying intervention rate.

stories.headline: Boom Supersonic lights its in-house engine core for the first time
stories.quote: BOOM SUPERSONIC LIGHTS ITS IN-HOUSE ENGINE CORE FOR THE FIRST TIME, A SIX-STAGE COMPRESSOR AND SINGLE-STAGE TURBINE SHARED BY A DATA CENTER TURBINE AND OVERTURE'S ENGINE

facts.text: The core reached 6,500 rpm on its second light-off attempt on a Colorado rig.
facts.quote: The core reached 6,500 rpm with nearly 2,000 sensors on its second light-off attempt

facts.text: The same core underpins the 42 MW Superpower gas turbine and the 40,000 lb Symphony turbofan.
facts.quote: The same core underpins the 42 MW Superpower gas turbine for AI data centers and the 40,000 lb Symphony turbofan for the Mach 1.7 Overture, with over 75% commonality.

stories.headline: Google's quantum processor wins a contextuality game 98.3% of the time against an 88.9% classical limit
stories.quote: GOOGLE'S QUANTUM PROCESSOR WINS A CONTEXTUALITY GAME 98.3% OF THE TIME AGAINST AN 88.9% CLASSICAL LIMIT, ACROSS TASKS UP TO 105 QUBITS

stories.headline: SpaceX lenders sought covenants barring Nvidia chips securing a $43B debt package from being launched into orbit
stories.quote: SPACEX LENDERS SOUGHT COVENANTS BARRING NVIDIA CHIPS SECURING A $43B DEBT PACKAGE FROM BEING LAUNCHED INTO ORBIT

facts.text: It is unclear whether the restriction made it into the final documents, led by Apollo and Goldman Sachs.
facts.quote: Whether the restriction made it into the final documents, led by Apollo and Goldman Sachs, remains unclear.

facts.text: SpaceX says the chips are for US data centers it owns and operates.
facts.quote: SpaceX says the chips are for US data centers it owns and operates, but Musk's orbital compute plans depend on launching silicon aboard Starship.

stories.headline: SK Hynix becomes Kioxia's largest shareholder with a 14.1% indirect stake
stories.quote: SK HYNIX BECOMES KIOXIA'S LARGEST SHAREHOLDER WITH A 14.1% INDIRECT STAKE

facts.text: The stake comes from converting an investment vehicle's bonds into 129,000 Kioxia shares and buying 1,001 more from Bain Capital; Toshiba holds 10.45%.
facts.quote: The stake comes from converting an investment vehicle's bonds into 129,000 Kioxia shares and buying 1,001 more from Bain Capital, which puts SK Hynix ahead of Toshiba at 10.45%.

stories.headline: TSMC reportedly pauses China shipments after new US rules on 16nm and 14nm logic chips
stories.quote: TSMC REPORTEDLY PAUSES CHINA SHIPMENTS AFTER NEW US RULES PRESUME 16NM AND 14NM LOGIC CHIPS ARE CONTROLLED

facts.text: TSMC told Chinese designers to halt 16nm-and-below orders without a US license.
facts.quote: TSMC told Chinese designers to halt 16nm-and-below orders without a US license, leaving them on 28nm and 40nm.
